picks.name: Wallabee Shoe, Maple Suede
picks.why: One of the Black Friday targets, now £79.20 (20% off) with UK 10 in stock, already under the target price a week early. There are no Wallabees in the wardrobe, and they fill both the office and everyday shoe slots without the weight of boots. Wear them with the fawn chinos and a navy knit, or the 502s and a raglan sweat. Spray the suede with protector first.

picks.name: 100% Merino Crew Neck Jumper, Navy
picks.why: The office outfit still has no knit, and this is the cheapest proper one: plain fine-gauge merino in navy, regular fit with ribbed cuffs and hem, no logo. Thin enough to sit under the field jacket too. Wear it over a plain tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs.

picks.name: 7006 Essential T-Shirt, Norway Spruce
picks.why: Tees remain the biggest gap, with most outfit formulas starting from one. This is a plain enzyme-washed organic cotton crew in a deep green-grey, 30% off, with just a tiny hem tab. Wear it under the raglan sweats or the navy merino crew with the 502s and Sambas.
